text: Apple (AAPL) iPhone 18 pre-orders run well ahead of last year's cycle, according to supply-chain checks. Analysts raised FQ4 revenue estimates ahead of the October 29 earnings report.
Earnings calendar: AAPL reports fiscal Q4 2026 on 2026-10-29 after market close. Consensus EPS 1.92.
NVIDIA Corp 8-K: announces a new $50B share repurchase authorization and raises data-center guidance.
Crude falls 6% on the week as OPEC+ signals higher output; integrated majors such as XOM trade lower.
